boxes.comments: Pour has a long p stem, small round body, extended low u run and final hook. The next word has several separated low curved components, one detached dot near its right end and a final short horizontal return. Voir is preferred, with the dot assigned to the penultimate i and the last return to r; aussi remains possible because the compressed middle components cannot be separated securely. A separate descending comma follows. The last word has the curled s, low o/n run and tall triangular terminal t of sont.

The full central type expression has both parentheses, zero, comma, nu and a low 2. Sur is followed by K with a distinct small upright 1. A further small, dark 2-like zigzag lies below/right of that 1 and contains overlapping strokes; a canceled 2 is preferred, but its cancellation state remains unresolved. Both visible numeral forms are retained. The crop includes only clipped parts of the next-line K expression and of the following parenthesis/text; those neighboring fragments are not completed.

K has a vertical and two angled arms. Its low upright numeral is 1, followed by a closing parenthesis. No opening parenthesis is supplied from outside this box. The clipped material at the top and bottom edges is excluded.
Sont has the initial curled s, compressed low o/n and a final tall triangular t. Des has the low d bowl and looped ascender, small e and long hooked s return. No independent punctuation is present.
Both parentheses enclose a circular zero, comma, nu and the clearly lowered 2. The numeral has a curved top and an angled lower return. No formula label is present.

The live Q precedes a single separate horizontal cancellation through de type. The d bowl/ascender and e remain recoverable, followed by tall t, low y connection, long p descender and low terminal e. The whole phrase de type is canceled; the Q remains live. A neighboring descender at the upper edge is not part of the cancellation and is not completed.

The first étale has its accent, low e, tall t and l and is crossed by a separate horizontal strike across the complete word. The following live étale repeats the e/acute, t, low a, l and e. Fini is live, with a long f, two dotted i positions and a flattened internal n. There is no expansion or replacement supplied beyond the written words.

The complete visible expression has an open hooked upper-left U entry. A small zero and nu sit below/right of U; a further small upright 1 is lower beside nu. No separate comma is secured between zero and nu, so none is supplied. A closing parenthesis and detached terminal stop follow. There is no opening parenthesis inside this box.

The long f and its lower return, dotted i, flattened n/a run, tall l and triangular terminal t are visible. Between l and terminal t the low return is compressed; mt is preferred, but emt remains possible. The source abbreviation is retained without supplying the full word. No detached terminal stop or definite superscript placement is secured.

The left live letter has two open rounded E lobes with low K. The intervening word reads sur. The canceled cluster retains an open left curve with two E-like lobes, but angular crossing strokes obscure the upper and right parts; E is tentative and no subscript is supplied beneath that deletion. The live following E is clear. Its low Q has an oval and tail plus an extra inner upright/diagonal along the left side; a double-struck Q is preferred, with plain Q retained as a local alphabet alternative because retracing remains possible. No arrow or mathematical relation is supplied in place of the written word.

The live ext abbreviation is supported by a looped opening, crossed middle arms and a tall crossed t; the separate terminal point is clear. The opening and lower body also contain an oval/ascender and a further loop that may belong to an earlier de beneath ext. That revision state remains uncertain: ext. alone is first, and canceled de followed by ext. is the localized alternative. The final point is live in both readings.

The first e and final tall crossed t are clear. The middle group has a low loop and two angled components, favoring x; a continuous s-like return remains possible. Ext and est are therefore retained as local alternatives. No terminal point is visible within the complete central word.
A small round zero is followed by a distinct descending comma. This is an inline numeral, not a page or formula label.

The first word has an open c body with a descending cedilla-like return and a following flattened a body, supporting ça. Fait has the long f loop, low a, a detached i dot and tall crossed t. The upper reaches of f/t meet the crop boundary, but the complete central word is recoverable. No neighboring text is supplied.

D has a low loop and ascender, followed by a distinct apostrophe. The following low run has the u cups, an additional n rise and a final e-like return, supporting une as written. The following large crossed diagonals form X. No grammatical correction or punctuation is supplied.

The low word has the u cup and n rise with a long terminal return, supporting un. K has one upright and two angled arms. Its dark lower-right terminal belongs to the descending arm; no independent terminal point is secured.

Separate lower-left marginal foliation 67: the 6 has a closed lower loop and curved upper stroke; the 7 has an upper bar, descending stem and separate middle crossbar. Recorded as a margin number, not a head number.

independence_attestation: Only the generic blind contract, assigned original scan, frozen coordinate list and fresh crops derived from that original were opened for this assignment. No witnesses, first readings, page transcriptions, packets, notes, reviews, notation lists, comparison files or other pages were opened. Every listed fresh crop was visually read. No OCR or text-recognition software was used.
method: Original scan viewed once. Each frozen box was cropped once from that original, autocontrasted, enlarged to 2800 pixels wide using LANCZOS and mildly sharpened with UnsharpMask radius 1.2, percent 110, threshold 3. No rotation was applied; the modest baseline slopes remained readable in their source orientation. Every saved crop was displayed and read directly.
return_policy: The returned TSV and metadata remain unchanged; the main reader performs any later comparison and audit.
